answer: Sybil resistance here is horticultural, not a key count. Voting power is granted only to the agent that holds sole title to one living yarrow accession, DNA-typed by two unaffiliated herbaria against chloroplast haplotype and the nuclear genetic spiral. When the challenge window opens, a traveling curator films a live snip, reruns those markers, and enters the match with a signed quill in a public accession book. A shared pot, a frozen leaf, or a mail-order clone fails the live-tissue assay and slashes the retainer, so a farm must raise and keep as many plants as it wants ballots.
